prompt: On a dry first Saturday, a visitor brings scraps in a pail and an empty bucket for compost. How should they handle the two containers?
promptZh: 每月第一個星期六沒有下雨，訪客帶了一個裝廚餘的桶子，還帶了一個空桶想領成品堆肥。兩個容器要怎麼用？

options.text: Empty the scraps into the marked tub, take the empty pail back, and use a separate bucket for finished compost.
options.zh: 把廚餘倒進指定桶，帶走倒空的桶子，另用一個桶子領成品堆肥。
options.whyZh: 送廚餘的容器要倒空後帶回；領成品堆肥要另外準備一個桶子。

options.text: Leave the scraps pail with the volunteers and collect the compost in any discarded container.
options.zh: 把裝廚餘的桶子留給志工，再用任何廢棄容器領堆肥。
options.whyZh: 送廚餘的容器必須帶回，領堆肥的桶子也要自備。

options.text: Keep the scraps in the pail and ask the volunteers to add compost on top.
options.zh: 不倒出廚餘，請志工直接把成品堆肥裝在上面。
options.whyZh: 廚餘要倒入指定回收桶，成品堆肥則另桶裝。

options.text: Empty the scraps and collect the compost in the same pail.
options.zh: 倒掉廚餘後，用同一個桶子領成品堆肥。
options.whyZh: 通知要求另帶一個桶子領堆肥，不能把同一個桶子當成兩用。

explanationZh: 送廚餘的容器要倒空後帶回；領成品堆肥要另外準備一個桶子。
evidence: Drop household fruit and vegetable scraps at the garden shed between 9 and 11. Please empty your scraps into the marked tub and take your container home. The volunteers cannot accept meat, fish or packaging, including bags sold as compostable. | Finished compost becomes available on the first Saturday of each month. Bring a separate bucket to collect it. In the market hall, volunteers can take incoming scraps but cannot give out finished compost. If scrap drop-off moves indoors on a compost collection day, the finished-compost collection is postponed; collect your share at the shed the following Saturday.

vocabulary.note: 已經完成處理、可領回使用的堆肥。
